glossary._note: Fixed terms every Spanish page must use. Brand 'uvaindex.org' and the abbreviations UVA, UVB, UVC, UV, SPF, PA, nm, W/m² stay as they are.
glossary.UVA Index: índice UVA (capitalise as 'Índice UVA' only at the start of a sentence or in titles)
glossary.band names (Low, Moderate, High, Very Hi: Bajo, Moderado, Alto, Muy alto, Extremo
glossary.tone: Use 'tú'. Clear, friendly, plain Spanish for a general audience (neutral international Spanish). Decimal comma in prose (0,5).
